job_spec.purpose: hardcore-1010 feasibility G (dual-track, -cl fe): ct = crpb (anchored pin flops, PS=0) + RSL. RSL=8 = ot_s81ph_cr_relay sliced one-hot read/write pointer copies (8 kept copies, each drives only its 70-bit slice of the 8-deep landing FIFO) + free-loading tx data register. Root cause: ct-split3crpb routed TT -66.17 / FF -0.47, worst class rx.rp -> 8:1 mux x553 -> tx.l_data enable (SS -185.8, 16 levels) = one pointer flop fanning out to ~4k loads. 0 cycles; RSL=0 byte-identical. Owner main lines untouched.
